text:
lina: Proposal: introduce a compact rollout header so resolvers can decide fallbacks w/o manifest fetch. Fields: bundle_label, sigil_v, compat_sigil, pin_strength, migration_id.

sam: +1. Keep bundle_label minimal (family/variant). compat_sigil = pipe-delimited k:v tokens. Example: 'hw:gpu|quant:int8|kv:2|api:1'.

kevin: Important: define parser rules. Delimiter '|' and kv separator ':'; order irrelevant. Unknown keys -> treat as incompatible by default.

anya: Ops wants deprecation_ts and fallback_chain for safe rollouts. Also migration_id for telemetry correlation.

ops-bot: runbook: created ticket RB-1987 to wire fallback alerts and migration playbook.

lina: Strawman JSON:
{
  "bundle_label": "redwood-rlm-13b/dense",
  "sigil_v": "1",
  "compat_sigil": "hw:gpu|quant:fp16|kv:2|api:stable",
  "pin_strength": "soft",
  "fallback_chain": ["redwood-rlm-13b/int8","redwood-rlm-13b/fp16"],
  "deprecation_ts": "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z",
  "migration_id": "mig-20261101-01"
}

sam: Wildcards: allow prefix-only wildcard in rollout rules (e.g., 'redwood-rlm-13b/*') but not in bundle_label values themselves. Keep resolver match O(1).

kevin: SDKs will provide tiny parser helpers for sigil_v=1. Older clients -> fetch manifest fallback.

anya: Telemetry: emit resolver_fallback event with {requested_label, chosen_label, reason_code, sigil_diff}. Ops threshold: alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% over 1h.

lina: Agreed. I'll update RFC and submit schema PR with these fields and examples. Thanks. :shipit:
